help: One paddle. Your angle.Clear the bricks without losing all three lives. Hit with the paddle’s edges to steer the ball.Keyboard← → or A D to move.SPACE to launch. P or ESC to pause.Mouse & touchMove the mouse or drag your finger to steer.Click or tap the arena to launch.Know your bricks.RegularNo symbol. Breaks with one hit.3ArmoredThe number and its color show hits remaining: cyan 3, gold 2, coral 1. Cracks spread after each hit. Armored bricks can start with two or three hits remaining.33 hits22 hits11 hitExplosiveBreak the star to deal one hit to nearby bricks. Explosives can trigger chain reactions; armored neighbors may survive.SwitchBreak the outlined diamond to open the formation’s glowing gates.Take in the story.World endings and high-score scenes wait for you. Use the visible Continue action when you’re ready, or press Space or Enter while the story heading is focused. Pause animation stops the scene and its music; Resume animation starts them again. P or Escape also toggles the animation while the story heading is focused. Reduced motion is available in Settings.Catch a little advantage.Wide paddleA wider paddle for 18 seconds. Works with sticky or laser.MultiballThree balls. Keep one in play.Sticky paddleHolds each ball where it lands for 16 seconds. Launch with space or a tap.Laser paddleFire automatically for 14 seconds.Piercing ballCut through bricks for 12 seconds.Slow motionSlower balls for 14 seconds.Safety shieldSaves one ball at the bottom.Extra lifeOne extra life, up to nine.How scoring works.Destroying a brick earns 100 × your combo multiplier. The combo counts bricks destroyed since the last paddle contact.Points per brick within a combo streakBRICKS IN STREAKMULTIPLIERPOINTS EACH1–5×11006–11×220012–17×330018–23×440024 onward×5500A 12-brick streak earns 2,000 points. Any ball touching the paddle resets the shared combo, including a Sticky catch. Losing all balls or starting a new board also resets it. Laser shots and explosion chains build that same combo; armored bricks score only when destroyed.Clear bonus: 750 + 150 × lives remaining. Clear with three lives for 1,200 bonus points. The first two Citadel and Nexus formations award 500 each; the final formation uses the normal clear bonus. Earn an extra life every 12,000 points, up to nine lives.Every collected power-up earns 150 points. Pickup points are added directly, without a combo multiplier. Multiball, Laser and Piercing can build brick combos. Wide, Slow and Shield help preserve lives. Sticky helps you aim, but each catch resets the combo. Each Extra life retained at a normal clear adds 150 to its bonus.Speed bonus: up to 2,000 points for each board. Subtract 10 points for every whole active second: a 40-second clear earns 1,600; a 100-second clear earns 1,000; at 200 seconds the bonus reaches zero. Each Citadel and Nexus formation earns its own speed bonus. Leaderboards rank by score, then world reached, then shortest active play time. Pauses, cutscenes and waiting to launch after a life loss do not count toward time. Losing a life or saving and resuming does not reset the board timer.Your personal best combines Adventure and Daily Challenge runs. Practice does not update it.Adventure follows all sixteen worlds. Practice lets you try any world. The daily challenge is the same seeded world for everyone on its UTC date.Got it
